name: Domino AR
summary:
Bring the domino table into your world.

Domino AR places a green game table right in your real surroundings thanks to Meta Quest passthrough: in your living room, your garden or by the sea. A virtual opponent sits in front of you, thinks, draws and plays tiles by hand, just like a real game across the table.

**Play naturally**
- Pick up tiles with a pinch (hand tracking) or with the controller grip
- The ends where your tile fits light up in green
- Grab the golden handles to move and rotate the table whe
